metadata.description: Agent harness skills: project-meta for repo memory and execution governance, dl-research for rigorous DL research workflows.

plugins.name: project-meta
plugins.description: Bootstrap, audit, and evolve a repository agent-work harness. Generates AGENTS.md, USER.md preferences, project-specific artifacts from skill-level templates, execution rules, and pre-commit delivery. Use when starting work in a repo, repairing memory layout, evolving agent instructions, coordinating complex work, or running /project-meta init|status|validate|deliver|audit.

plugins.name: dl-research
plugins.description: Guide rigorous Deep Learning research studies: initialize a project research adapter, frame questions, survey evidence, design controlled experiments, prepare/launch/monitor runs, evaluate results, synthesize findings, audit methodology, or run a bounded autonomous ratchet loop.

plugins.name: deep-survey-bfs
plugins.description: Conduct rigorous breadth-first literature surveys: frame the research question with sub-question decomposition, broad multi-source search (arXiv/OpenReview/DBLP/Semantic Scholar), 4-dimension paper rating, sub-question x dimension coverage matrix gap audit, targeted gap-filling rounds, multi-axis taxonomy + timeline + per-paper deep-dives synthesis, source/institution/year/method bias audit, citation-graph (Mermaid) rendering, single-file interactive HTML export with tooltips/search/Plotly/dark-mode, and incremental versioned reports as new evidence arrives. Reference example: skills/deep-survey-bfs/examples/stereo-matching-edge-fm/ (26 papers, 67 claims, full HTML render). Use when the user asks for a literature review, comprehensive survey, or wants to expand/audit an existing survey.

plugins.name: profile-creator
plugins.description: Create a new Claude Code config profile in a multi-claude setup: a ~/.claude-<name>/ dir with its own CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, a ~/.local/bin launcher, and a shared-plugins symlink. Plugin administration is centralized via the ccplug wrapper so installLocation/installPath never drift across profiles. Use to add a new multi-claude profile, spin up an isolated config directory for a different account/context, or onboard a profile to the shared plugin store.
